messages:
sara (Support): Heads-up — invoice on hold. Acme GmbH requested VAT-exemption / reverse-charge for invoice INV-2027-019. They supplied a VAT ID but a quick VIES check looked off (name mismatch). Can finance advise what we need to unblock?

liam (Finance): Please post the invoice id + the VAT number here. If VIES fails we need a copy of the official VAT registration or a resale certificate.

sara (Support): Invoice/ID below:
```
invoice: INV-2027-019
amount: EUR 12,450.00
customer: Acme GmbH
vat_id_provided: DE123456789
```
They sent an email claiming reverse-charge (B2B) and attached a PDF that looks like a commercial invoice but not the official VAT reg cert.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2027-019 status updated → ON_HOLD (reason: tax_exemption_requested). Assigned to @liam (Finance).

liam (Finance): Ran VIES lookup for `DE123456789` — lookup either timed out or returned a different legal name (Acme Solutions GmbH). When the VAT name doesn't match billing/legal name we require: a) the official VAT registration certificate showing that VAT ID, OR b) a reseller / exemption certificate that specifically references the transaction AND a company registration extract showing DBA mapping. Screenshot of VIES is helpful but not sufficient if mismatch.

marco (Account Manager): I flagged this to the customer. They replied that they are a reseller and will provide a resale certificate + proof of tax status. Asked them to use the secure upload link. cc @sara

olga (Engineering): Note: use the portal secure-upload endpoint (internal): https://console.redwood-internal/upload-docs?ref=INV-2027-019 — this drops files into our encrypted S3 bucket and auto-tags customer id. If support needs, I can generate a one-time upload token.

sara (Support): Sent the link and token to the customer. Told them we need:
- official VAT registration PDF (authority-issued) OR reseller certificate signed by authorized person
- a VIES screenshot showing the VAT ID (if VIES reports success)
- company registry extract if the legal name differs (showing DBA or translation)

liam (Finance): Important: for German reverse-charge (B2B) we need the VAT ID to validate under EU rules (Article 196). If they cannot provide a valid DE VAT ID + matching legal name we must charge VAT. If they provide documents, finance will perform a manual override and issue a corrected invoice/credit as needed. ETA: 24–48h after docs verified.

billing-bot: Upload received for INV-2027-019 (3 files). Files: `acme_vat_cert.pdf`, `vies_screenshot.png`, `company_extract.pdf`

liam (Finance): Received. Quick scan: the `acme_vat_cert.pdf` is an authority-stamped PDF but lists the company legal name as "Acme Solutions GmbH" while invoice says "Acme GmbH". `company_extract.pdf` shows a registered DBA mapping ("Acme GmbH" trading as "Acme Solutions GmbH"). This is acceptable if the extract clearly links the VAT ID to the invoiced entity. I'll run a one-time manual VIES + internal cross-check and then release.

marco (Account Manager): Customer asked whether a translated certificate is needed — replied: English translation recommended but not mandatory if the registry doc is official and clearly maps names.

liam (Finance): Manual override done — invoice MOVED to PENDING_RELEASE. I flagged for final check and will release payment terms change. Will also send a corrected invoice showing reverse-charge (VAT 0%) and a short note referencing Article 196.

sara (Support): Noted. I will update the customer: we accepted their documents and are issuing a corrected invoice under reverse-charge.

liam (Finance): Done — corrected invoice and credit note issued. Payment terms unchanged. Sent to customer via email and attached to billing portal.

sara (Support): Closing the ticket — customer confirmed receipt and will process payment net 30. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

liam (Finance): Leaving a short audit note: docs saved under billing/audits/2027/INV-2027-019 and VIES lookup snapshot in the ticket.

olga (Engineering): If support runs into more customer-upload confusion, I can add a short checklist to the upload page (required docs list) to reduce back-and-forth.

sara (Support): Good idea. Filing a tiny UX request. End of thread.
